title: Weltgenerierung, Baeume, natuerliches Spawnen, Rezepte, Loot
goal: Overworld and dimension decoration from OreSpawnWorld, the structure infrastructure every dungeon uses, Trees, BasiliskMaze, RubyBirdDungeon, DungeonSpawnerBlock, ItemRandomDungeon, ItemMagicApple, the natural spawns from BiomeGenUtopianPlains and the 348 addSpawn entries, 381 recipes, 9 chest loot entries and the dispenser completeness check (docs/catalog/README.md section 4.13 and verhalten/world-02.md, world-04.md, core-01a.md, core-01b.md). GenericDungeon itself is wave W13 and builds on the infrastructure written here: every call into GenericDungeon from OreSpawnWorld or items becomes // PORT: TODO W13 with the exact original method name and arguments. Per DECISIONS R12: a Feature when the footprint fits the 3x3-chunk window, otherwise a Structure with StructurePieces whose postProcess writes only inside the given BoundingBox; recently_placed -> structure_set spacing/separation, Math.random -> seed + ChunkPos (R18); surface search via WORLD_SURFACE_WG heightmap (R18). ORDER CHANGE (user request 2026-09-13): this wave runs BEFORE W09-W11 (and before W13). Entities of W09 (mounts, dragons, robots vehicles), W10 (bosses, King/Queen, Kraken, Mobzilla, Prince line) and W11 (cages, Easter Bunny) do not exist yet: every spawner, tree-top boss, natural spawn entry or loot referencing them is written against the registry id string (manifest id) and guarded so a missing type is skipped at runtime, and marked // PORT: TODO W09/W10/W11 so that wave wires it. Read docs/port/W01.md up to W08.md and FIX1.md first. Spawning during chunk generation: before porting natural spawns, verify with javap in reference/jar/mcp/client-1.7.10.jar whether 1.7.10 SpawnerAnimals.performWorldGenSpawning called getCanSpawnHere, and make the 1.21.1 chunk-generation spawn path (SpawnPlacements / checkSpawnRules with MobSpawnType.CHUNK_GENERATION) behave the same; document the finding in docs/port/W12.md.

workers.task: Write the structure infrastructure: a clipped block writer that ports the original setBlock/metadata calls into a BoundingBox-clipped StructurePiece write (1.7.10 metadata -> 1.21.1 BlockState conversion helper for torches, stairs, levers, buttons, pistons, chests per catalogue 6.4 - verify each meta convention in reference/jar/mcp/client-1.7.10.jar), a chest loot filler porting WeightedRandomChestContent, a generic Structure type + piece type registration pattern, and structure_set/biome tag conventions. Then port OreSpawnWorld: every per-chunk decoration and its placement rule per dimension as Features/Structures (config switches from OreSpawnConfig via placement modifiers), ore placed features for the Overworld through a biome modifier with a config-count placement modifier (Y bands absolute, stone and deepslate replaceables per R18). Calls into Trees/BasiliskMaze/RubyBirdDungeon use those class names (written in parallel by w12-trees-mazes); calls into GenericDungeon become // PORT: TODO W13.

Port Trees (all tree generators with their exact block layouts; the fairy spawner in the fairy tree uses the W07 Fairy), BasiliskMaze (L), RubyBirdDungeon (S), DungeonSpawnerBlock (L), ItemRandomDungeon (needs a solid block, catalogue 6.8) and ItemMagicApple (L; 1% Ginormous Tree per code, catalogue 6.8), plus the tree growth of ItemAppleSeed/ItemExperienceTreeSeed left as TODO W12 in W02. Write them as Feature classes where the footprint fits the 3x3-chunk window, otherwise as StructurePieces using the clipped writer from world/structure/ (written in parallel by w12-infra-overworld - agree on its API by reading that package once it exists; if it is not there yet, write your pieces against a minimal interface you declare in world/tree/ and report the adaptation need).
owns: files for the ids of these classes (blockstates, models, loot tables)

workers.task: Port the natural spawning: the BiomeModifier type orespawn:config_spawns (MapCodec registration via registry_entries) that reads the spawn table (generate it from docs/catalog/manifest.json entities[].spawns into a data file) with the 1.7.10 -> 1.21.1 biome mapping in docs/catalog/biome_map.json (merge rule: per entity and target biome the larger entry, R18), checks the COMMON enable flags and AllMobsDisable, and uses the MobCategory of the original addSpawn type (R18). Add the spawn entries missing from the manifest (catalogue 6.6: Mobzilla in VillageMania, GoldFish, Irukandji, LeafMonster, HerculesBeetle, the dino list of ChunkProviderOreSpawn2, Halloween Ghost/GhostSkelly) and port BiomeGenUtopianPlains' spawn lists for the OreSpawn dimension biomes. Date-based spawns checked at server start (R18). Fill the 'TODO W12' spawn back-edges.

Generate the 381 recipes from docs/catalog/recipes.json with a new generator tools/gen_recipes.py into src/main/resources/data/orespawn/recipe/ (shaped, shapeless, smelting; list-valued ingredients become multi-item ingredients; water-bucket egg rehydration recipes map vanilla spawn_egg metas to 1.21.1 egg items; OreDictionary -> c: tags per R14; config-dependent recipes like MinersDreamExpensive via a NeoForge condition - verify that ModConfigSpec values are readable when recipe conditions are evaluated, catalogue 6.3, otherwise document the fallback). Port the 9 ChestGenHooks entries as a Global Loot Modifier (codec registration via registry_entries, data/orespawn/loot_modifiers/ and the neoforge global_loot_modifiers list). Check that every dispenser behaviour of the original is registered (eggs from W01-W11, projectiles from W04) and report gaps.

Close two R21 open points from docs/port/FIX1.md (no original class of its own): (1) Crystal and Chaos dimensions still use vanilla placed-feature decoration; R21 requires the ported 1.7.10 Java decoration (BiomeDecorator/WorldGen* in world/gen, as Utopia and Mining now use) - port ChunkProviderOreSpawn5/6 populate decoration exactly and remove their vanilla feature JSON. (2) legacyPanic exists in five copies (grep legacyPanic): merge into one helper in entity/ai and fix the call sites without changing behaviour. Write what changed into docs/port/W12.md section R21-Nachzug. Do not touch OreSpawnWorld or the tree/maze classes (other porters).
owns: the legacyPanic copies and their call sites

gametests: each Feature and Structure of this wave places completely in a test world and writes only inside its BoundingBox (compare the block count against the original method's writes for one sample per worker); the config_spawns modifier adds spawn entries only when the enable flag is set and uses the mapped 1.21.1 biomes; a sample of 20 recipes (shaped, shapeless, smelting, rehydration) matches recipes.json; a vanilla dungeon chest roll can contain an OreSpawn loot entry; ItemMagicApple and ItemRandomDungeon build their structures; all earlier tests still pass.
